technical_incident.what: attempt 1 of the run returned HTTP 422 on all 72 requests (1,296 gate rows, zero noul values)
technical_incident.cause: noul criteria was serialized as a plain string; the TypeSafe API requires noul criteria as an object with true/false descriptions (Choice-style string criteria is not valid for noul)
technical_incident.fix: schema-only conversion of each criteria string into {true,false} halves split from its own YES/NO wording; instructions and all semantics unchanged; no responses had been received, so no test-set information influenced anything
